COMMON QUESTIONS

What counts as one free itinerary?

Each generation of a unique trip (destination + dates + preferences) counts as one. Viewing or sharing an existing itinerary does not consume your free generation.

When do my itinerary credits reset?

Your credits reset on your monthly billing date. Free users receive 5 itineraries per rolling 30-day window. Premium subscribers receive 10 itineraries per billing cycle, renewed automatically each month.

Is my payment information secure?

Payments are handled entirely by Stripe. TravalBee never stores your card details.

Do you offer refunds?

We offer refunds within 7 days of purchase if you are not satisfied. See our Refund Policy for details.
